subject: Multi-cloud channel: proposed SKU grid and co-sell play
messages:
From: Ilya Popov <ilya@cloudark.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sree Nair <sree@cloudark.com>, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-15T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + marketplace alignment: initial SKU grid concept

Hi Hannah — great to meet last week. Sree and I put together a very rough SKU grid and region mapping for listing Redwood on AWS/Azure/GCP and for enabling co-sell motions from our side. High level asks:

- Confirm which product variants Redwood wants public in each marketplace (hosted API; dedicated reserved capacity; private/VPC offering).
- Identify a canonical SKU name taxonomy we can push to AWS/Azure/GCP (avoid per-cloud renames where possible).
- Any regulatory region exclusions we should be aware of for co-sell enablement (E.g., controlled data regions).

I attached a starting spreadsheet (redwood-sku-proposal-v2.xlsx) with suggested SKUs, short descriptions, and recommended fulfillment types. Can you and your GTM folks review and tell us which 3–4 SKUs you want prioritized for initial co-sell enablement?

We can also loop in the AWS Partner team to coordinate listings and co-sell enablement timelines after you confirm.

Cheers,
Ilya
Ilya Popov
Marketplace Partnerships, CloudArk
ilya@cloudark.com
+1 415-555-0198

--
Attachment: redwood-sku-proposal-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Ilya Popov <ilya@cloudark.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-15T17:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + marketplace alignment: initial SKU grid concept

Thanks Ilya — received, and the spreadsheet is a great starting point. A few quick notes from my side after an initial pass:

- Prioritize parity for the Hosted API SKU across AWS/Azure/GCP (same name + SKU code) to keep onboarding docs simple for customers.
- For Dedicated (reserved capacity) we need to show region-level fulfillment options: US-east1/US-west2 for GA; EU-west1 for early EU customers; APAC later.
- Private/VPC should be packaged as an enterprise SKU with persona-based SKUs (security-only listing vs full private deployment).

I'll coordinate an internal sync with Vivek and Rafael to land a recommended 3-SKU set for initial co-sell. Tentative internal deadline: Wed 7/17 EOD. After that, Ilya, can we schedule a 30-minute alignment with CloudArk + AWS partner team on 7/20?

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai

On Thu, Jul 15, 2026 at 3:02 PM Ilya wrote:
> Hi Hannah — great to meet last week. Sree and I put together a very rough SKU grid...

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-16T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + marketplace alignment: initial SKU grid concept

Team — quick strategic points before we lock SKUs:

1) Uniform naming is ideal, but we must plan for marketplace idiosyncrasies (e.g., Azure requires different fulfillment descriptors for SaaS vs. VM-based offers). Work with product to create a short canonical SKU label plus per-marketplace metadata (not different public names).

2) For co-sell eligibility: prioritize a single GA-ready SKU per marketplace that maps to our Hosted API but includes an "enterprise upgrade" flag (Dedicated + Private) so partners can escalate deals without listing extra discrete SKUs initially. That reduces approval friction for co-sell certification.

3) Pricing strategy: no permanent discounts on the marketplace listing. Use partner-managed promotions for co-sell motion; Redwood will roll transient promotional pricing when mutually agreed. Document this in the mutual action plan.

4) Compliance/region: any EU/UK customer targeting must have entries pointing to EU fulfillment endpoints (we cannot route EU-customer data through non-EU endpoints). Put a hard requirement in the sheet and flag any SKUs that don't meet it.

Hannah — Rafael should lead the SKU/pricing rows; Jonas to handle partner enablement notes and required artifacts for AWS/Azure co-sell certification. Let's keep this tight — aim to lock the initial bundle by EOD 7/17.

Vivek
VP, Global Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Ilya Popov <ilya@cloudark.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-16T11:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + marketplace alignment: initial SKU grid concept

Ilya — thanks for the spreadsheet. A few product/pricing choices I'm proposing for the initial listing:

- SKU A: Redwood Hosted API (on-demand) — public listing; metered per-token usage; target customers: devs/SMB. Fulfillment: native SaaS subscription on each marketplace.
- SKU B: Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) — marketplace listing will be "request a quote" with fulfillment via direct Redwood contract and marketplace procurement add-on. Prioritize US-east and EU-west for GA.
- SKU C: Redwood Private (VPC / on-prem) — enterprise-only, not publicly listed pricing; listing entry points to contact + DocuSign MSA.

Operational asks:
- We need the CloudArk partner team to own initial co-sell certification paperwork for AWS. Jonas, can you list the artifacts CloudArk will need?
- Attachments: added draft procurement flow to the sheet, plus checklist (CloudArk_Marketplace_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf).

If CloudArk can get us expected timelines for partner enablement per marketplace (AWS/Azure/GCP), we can map a go-to-market calendar.

-Rafael
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Sree Nair <sree@cloudark.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ilya Popov <ilya@cloudark.com>, aws-partner-team@amazon.com
Date: 2026-07-17T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + marketplace alignment: initial SKU grid concept

Thanks Rafael — a couple of clarifying questions from CloudArk:

1) For "request a quote" SKUs (Dedicated): do you want the same SKU code across marketplaces or unique codes that reference the marketplace in the ID? We prefer a stable external SKU to track performance across clouds.
2) For Private/VPC: will Redwood provide a hardened AMI/container image for marketplace fulfillment on Azure and GCP, or will CloudArk coordinate provisioning via a partner-run deployment? The answer affects the co-sell enablement checklist.

We can also push to AWS Partner team to arrange an intro with their Marketplace Listings PM if you want — tagging them here. Proposed next steps: Hannah/Rafael send final 3 SKU choices by EOD 7/17; CloudArk will return a partner enablement timeline by 7/20 so we can lock the co-sell kickoff meeting.

Best,
Sree
Head of Marketplace Partnerships, CloudArk

Attachment: CloudArk_Marketplace_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (PDF, 18KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Ilya Popov <ilya@cloudark.com>, Sree Nair <sree@cloudark.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-19T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + marketplace alignment: initial SKU grid concept

All — appreciate the quick turn. Rafael and I reviewed internally and we are locking the initial public-facing SKU set:

- SKU-RED-01: Redwood Hosted API (metered SaaS) — public, same name across AWS/Azure/GCP.
- SKU-RED-02: Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) — marketplace listing = request-a-quote; fulfillment via direct Redwood contract (US + EU regions at GA).
- SKU-RED-03: Redwood Private (VPC/On-prem) — enterprise listing with contact + DocuSign flow; not price-disclosed.

Action items:
- Rafael to populate final pricing bands and the canonical SKU codes in the attached spreadsheet by EOD 7/19.
- Jonas to draft the partner artifact checklist required for AWS/Azure co-sell certification (expected deliverables + owner).
- Ilya/Sree to confirm CloudArk enablement timeline by 7/20 and share the AWS Partner PM intro thread.
- Hannah to schedule the 7/20 30-min alignment (calendar invite to follow).

I'll attach the updated spreadsheet with SKU codes once Rafael finishes pricing. If CloudArk needs a hardened image spec for Private/VPC, Rafael will coordinate with Product to supply an image spec doc.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Hannah
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
